control.pageHead:
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<style>

html, body { margin:0; }
#ee_divRoot { position:relative !important; inset:auto !important; width:100% !important; height:auto !important; min-height:100dvh; overflow:visible !important; background:#f7f7fc; }
#ee_divRoot, #ee_divRoot * { box-sizing:border-box; }
#ee_divRoot a { color:#46368b; text-underline-offset:.16em; }
#ee_divRoot a:focus-visible, #ee_divRoot [role=button]:focus-visible, #ee_divRoot input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #7c63d2; outline-offset:2px; }
#ee_divRoot h1,#ee_divRoot h2,#ee_divRoot h3,#ee_divRoot p,#ee_divRoot pre { margin:0; }
#ee_divRoot h1 { font:750 clamp(28px,5vw,48px)/1.12 system-ui,sans-serif; }
#ee_divRoot h2 { font:720 clamp(21px,3vw,30px)/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif; }
#ee_divRoot h3 { font:700 19px/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif; }
#ee_divRoot pre { white-space:pre-wrap; overflow-wrap:anywhere; font:14px/1.55 ui-monospace,monospace; }
#ee_divRoot code { overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
:where(#ee_divRoot) [id^="ee_"] {
position:relative !important; inset:auto !important; width:100% !important; height:auto !important; overflow:visible !important;
}
:where(#ee_divRoot) [id^="ee_"] > div:has(> table) { position:relative !important; inset:auto !important; height:auto !important; width:100% !important; overflow:visible !important; }
:where(#ee_divRoot) [id^="ee_"] > div > table { position:relative !important; inset:auto !important; height:auto !important; width:100% !important; white-space:normal !important; border-collapse:collapse; }
:where(#ee_divRoot) [id^="ee_"] td { padding:0; line-height:1.55; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
#ee_page { width:100% !important; }
#ee_wrap { max-width:1120px; margin-inline:auto; padding:clamp(16px,4vw,40px); }
#ee_blog { padding:clamp(22px,5vw,54px) max(16px,calc((100% - 1040px)/2)); }
#ee_theFeaturesGuideNowCoversTheFull,
#ee_tryTheInteractionExamples { border:1px solid #e3dff2; border-radius:12px; padding:clamp(15px,3vw,24px); margin-block:14px; }
#ee_blog2,
#ee_updatesAboutTheEpageWebsiteAndIts,
#ee_theFeaturesGuideNowCoversTheFull2,
#ee_theGuideExplainsTheStudioWorkspaceControls,
#ee_readTheFeaturesGuide2,
#ee_tryTheInteractionExamples2,
#ee_theExamplesPageNowLetsYouSwitch,
#ee_openExamples2 { margin-block:6px; }
#ee_readTheFeaturesGuide,
#ee_openExamples { display:flex !important; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px 12px; }
#ee_readTheFeaturesGuide2,
#ee_openExamples2 { width:max-content !important; max-width:100%; }
#ee_blog2 td { line-height:1.2; }
#ee_theFeaturesGuideNowCoversTheFull2 td,#ee_tryTheInteractionExamples2 td { line-height:1.2; }
</style>

control.text: Updates about the ePage website and its examples.
The Features guide now covers the full workflow
The guide explains the Studio workspace, controls, layout, JavaScript, and publishing. Screen captures show how the interface is organized.
The Examples page now lets you switch views, change a preview palette, and filter a sample table directly in the browser.
